verdict.rationale: Jules natively creates a PR once a task completes (jules-docs-8), and the API exposes an `automationMode` field to configure automatic PR creation on task completion, with plan approval configurable via `requirePlanApproval` (jules-docs-11, jules-docs-16). Community evidence corroborates PRs being produced from tasks (jules-comm-12, jules-comm-16). Missing for 10: independent verification of automationMode reliability/config nuances and more detail on failure-mode handling when tasks don't fully complete.
